provider.name: Dodgy's Dungeon
provider.tagline: ICT-style trading education and live streams from Ryan ("Dodgy"), built around his iFVG methodology.
provider.about: Dodgy's Dungeon is a trading education community run by Ryan ("Dodgy"), teaching ICT-style concepts — market structure, order blocks, fair value gaps, liquidity — with a focus on his own iFVG (Implied Fair Value Gap) methodology. A free Discord community includes a free ICT bootcamp course and daily live streams; the paid products below add more on top of that.
provider.partner_firms_note: "Alpha Futures" is a different company from "Alpha Funded", which is the firm we list separately — we haven't linked it here to avoid mixing the two up.

courses.name: iFVG Ultimate+ Indicator
courses.tagline: A real-time indicator for spotting Implied Fair Value Gap setups.
courses.about: A standalone trading indicator (not a full course) that detects Implied Fair Value Gap setups in real time, with a built-in setup-grading system. Works across all currency pairs and timeframes.

formats.label: Real-time indicator
formats.description: Detects iFVG setups live on your charts, with 10 customizable settings.

formats.label: Setup grading
formats.description: Grades detected setups so you can judge quality at a glance.

courses.name: Dodgy's Dungeon Premium
courses.tagline: Live trading streams, premium Discord access and the Ultimate Trading Course.
courses.about: The paid membership tier on top of the free community: live trading streams every market morning, a premium Discord channel with deeper iFVG methodology breakdowns, and access to the Ultimate Trading Course.

formats.label: Live trading streams
formats.description: Ryan trades live every market morning, with real-time commentary.

formats.label: Premium Discord
formats.description: Deeper iFVG methodology breakdowns and setup walkthroughs.

formats.label: Ultimate Trading Course
formats.description: A structured course included with membership.

testimonials.quote: Dodgy is a bright young man with an amazing trading strategy. Most people hate on him because he is honest and doesn't tell you what you want to hear.
testimonials.author: Steve Vigil

testimonials.quote: Ryan has helped me be a better trader. I now know when to leave the charts, when to take partials and trail stop loss.
testimonials.author: Qazi Omair Ahmed

testimonials.quote: The streams are very educational, even if the PA sucks and held very professional. The indicator is very helpful.
testimonials.author: Oliver Eilhardt
